decision.text: Scale = probability, default 0.5 not sure, over 0.7 needs named evidence, under 0.3 probably wrong. Alternative: default 1.0 as multiplier; rejected because a multiplier reads as a weight, the exact 0.9 misreading. See ext/Refine/doc/confidence.md
